name: @pineappleui/icons
description: Icon primitive for @pineappleui — a wrapper over Lucide with design-system size tokens and decorative-by-default a11y.

pineapple.refTestNotApplicable: Icon owns its whole prop list -- name, size, label -- rather than passing a DOM element's props through, and `IconProps` declares no `ref`. There is no forwarded ref for a consumer to hold, so a ref test here would assert lucide-react's behaviour rather than this package's. Widening the public API to carry a ref is the change that would make one meaningful.
